rationale: The sole failure is the agent omitting additionalProperties:false from tool schemas. Adding an explicit, unconditional instruction in the core procedural text directly closes this gap without altering any other behavior.
expected_effect: Agent will include additionalProperties:false on every tool input schema, satisfying the STRICT_SCHEMA_ADDITIONAL_PROPERTIES verifier for notes-store and all future tool definitions.
